label: P1-prime from Aristotelian modality at every world, by instantiation
meaning: Instantiation (a weakening, not a substantive derivation): Aristotelian modality at every world, instantiated at w and at the proposition NoActualContingentConcreteIn F concrete w, is P1-prime, on the same frame, power primitive, concreteness predicate and world. The converse fails (the controls' separator). As a transcription it closes P1-prime only if the universal principle is closed, and it never expands P1-prime in the route-cost diagnostic. It records that P1-prime is one instance of a principle the Pruss routes use at several propositions, not new warrant for it.
